public_art.location: open space in front of building
public_art.art_requirement_note: Predates the 1985 Downtown Plan; the art was provided under approvals guided by the pending plan.
public_art.detail: This stainless-steel sculpture, 96 inches in diameter and 14 inches deep, forms four intersecting cones that each trace the sun's path through the solar year.
